text: Welcome to the examination. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; please tell me, how many days old is the baby and was there any difficulty during the delivery or birth?

text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.
